title: Detailed piano
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- Piano body -->
  <rect x="10" y="30" width="80" height="55" rx="6" fill="#8B2E3F"/>
  <!-- Top panel highlight -->
  <rect x="14" y="34" width="72" height="10" rx="3" fill="#B54457"/>
  <!-- Lid top -->
  <rect x="14" y="24" width="72" height="10" rx="4" fill="#A03548"/>
  <rect x="14" y="24" width="72" height="4" rx="2" fill="#C65567"/>
  <!-- Music stand -->
  <rect x="34" y="14" width="32" height="14" rx="2" fill="#6E2030"/>
  <rect x="37" y="17" width="26" height="8" rx="1" fill="#E8D9B0"/>
  <line x1="40" y1="21" x2="60" y2="21" stroke="#8B6E40" stroke-width="1"/>
  <line x1="40" y1="19" x2="60" y2="19" stroke="#8B6E40" stroke-width="1"/>
  <!-- Keys area white background -->
  <rect x="16" y="48" width="68" height="28" rx="2" fill="#F5EFDC"/>
  <!-- White keys -->
  <rect x="18" y="50" width="7" height="24" rx="1" fill="#FFFDF5"/>
  <rect x="26" y="50" width="7" height="24" rx="1" fill="#F0EAD6"/>
  <rect x="34" y="50" width="7" height="24" rx="1" fill="#FFFDF5"/>
  <rect x="42" y="50" width="7" height="24" rx="1" fill="#F0EAD6"/>
  <rect x="50" y="50" width="7" height="24" rx="1" fill="#FFFDF5"/>
  <rect x="58" y="50" width="7" height="24" rx="1" fill="#F0EAD6"/>
  <rect x="66" y="50" width="7" height="24" rx="1" fill="#FFFDF5"/>
  <rect x="74" y="50" width="8" height="24" rx="1" fill="#F0EAD6"/>
  <!-- Black keys -->
  <rect x="22" y="50" width="4" height="15" rx="1" fill="#3D1A24"/>
  <rect x="30" y="50" width="4" height="15" rx="1" fill="#4D2230"/>
  <rect x="46" y="50" width="4" height="15" rx="1" fill="#3D1A24"/>
  <rect x="54" y="50" width="4" height="15" rx="1" fill="#4D2230"/>
  <rect x="62" y="50" width="4" height="15" rx="1" fill="#3D1A24"/>
  <rect x="70" y="50" width="4" height="15" rx="1" fill="#4D2230"/>
  <!-- Front lip -->
  <rect x="14" y="72" width="72" height="5" rx="2" fill="#7A2535"/>
  <!-- Legs -->
  <rect x="18" y="77" width="6" height="12" rx="2" fill="#5E1A28"/>
  <rect x="76" y="77" width="6" height="12" rx="2" fill="#5E1A28"/>
  <!-- Pedals -->
  <rect x="44" y="85" width="4" height="6" rx="1" fill="#D4AF37"/>
  <rect x="52" y="85" width="4" height="6" rx="1" fill="#D4AF37"/>
  <!-- Decorative gold trim -->
  <line x1="16" y1="46" x2="84" y2="46" stroke="#D4AF37" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="16" y1="70" x2="84" y2="70" stroke="#D4AF37" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <!-- Shine on lid -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="27" rx="20" ry="3" fill="#E07080" opacity="0.5"/>
</svg>
